SELECT wr.* FROM work_release wr WHERE wr.work_item_id = ? AND wr.revise_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_decision d WHERE d.work_item_id = wr.work_item_id AND d.kind = 'revise' ) ORDER BY ( SELECT MAX(r.id) FROM reservation r WHERE r.release_digest = wr.release_digest ) DESC NULLS LAST, wr.id DESC LIMIT 1
